code_name: Chips, tab bar, notification bubbles at 9:16
summary: Three 9:16 scenes that show animated icons in a believable app: lock-screen notification bubbles with a bell and badge, feature label chips that land one by one, and a tab bar whose active icon plays as a pill moves between tabs.
